experiment.perturbation: Resource/economy/low-carbon group weights each multiplied by independent Uniform(0.8,1.2), then normalized; same draws for both models
experiment.interpretation: Frequencies concern the specified preference scenarios, not confidence in real-world project success.

spatial.weight: Directed centroid k-nearest, row-standardized, geographic haversine distance; no self-neighbor
spatial.localCorrection: Conditional two-sided permutation p, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR q<=0.05
spatial.interpretation: Spatial concentration of the baseline research score, not causal development spillover or power transmission.
